data.notes: February 2027 is anchored by Carnaval, with a handful of stadium-scale international concerts and select independent/alternative events already confirmed.

events.title: Carnaval SP 2027 — Official Samba School Parades
events.summary: Liga-SP confirms the official São Paulo samba school parades return to Anhembi on February 5, 6 and 7, 2027. This is the city’s flagship music-and-carnival event for the month.

events.title: Karol G — Viajando Por El Mundo Tropitour
events.summary: Ticketmaster Brasil confirms Karol G’s São Paulo stadium date for February 12, 2027 at Mercado Livre Arena Pacaembu. The show is part of the Viajando Por El Mundo Tropitour.

events.title: Carnaval SP 2027 — Desfile das Campeãs
events.summary: Liga-SP lists the 2027 Champions Parade for February 13 at the Sambódromo do Anhembi. The night follows the main competition with the top São Paulo samba schools returning to the avenue.

events.title: Foo Fighters — Take Cover Tour 2027
events.summary: Live Nation lists Foo Fighters’ Take Cover Tour 2027 at Estádio do MorumBIS on February 20, 2027. Ticketmaster’s event page also lists the São Paulo show at 20:00 with gates at 16:00.

events.title: Carnaval de Rua SP 2027
events.summary: SPTuris’ official 2027 portaria lists the main Carnaval de Rua dates as February 6–9, 2027. Individual bloco routes and artist details were not yet fully announced, so this entry covers the confirmed official street-carnival window.

events.title: Laura Pausini — Io Canto / Yo Canto World Tour
events.summary: The official Io Canto World Tour site lists Laura Pausini in São Paulo at Mercado Livre Arena Pacaembu on February 27, 2027. Tickets are listed through Tickets for Fun.

events.title: Jack Johnson — SURFILMUSIC Tour Brasil 2027
events.summary: Eventim lists Jack Johnson at Nubank Parque on February 20, 2027. The São Paulo date is promoted as part of the SURFILMUSIC Tour Brasil and has Ben Harper & The Innocent Criminals as special guests in the city.

events.title: Placebo — RE:CREATED Tour
events.summary: Suhai Music Hall confirms Placebo for February 20, 2027 as part of the RE:CREATED Tour celebrating the band’s debut album. The show is produced by Mercury Concerts.

events.title: Xuxa — O Último Voo da Nave
events.summary: Eventim lists Xuxa’s O Último Voo da Nave São Paulo performance at Nubank Parque on February 27, 2027. The show is a large-scale pop/nostalgia production from one of Brazil’s most recognizable TV and music figures.

events.title: Wave Festival Carnaval 2027
events.summary: Wave Festival Brasil confirms its Carnaval edition at Madame Club with The March Violets, Bragolin and Carrellee. The independent/alternative festival is listed for February 6, 2027, from 18:00 to 23:00.

events.title: Buena Vista Social Orchestra
events.summary: Clube do Ingresso lists Buena Vista Social Orchestra in São Paulo at Teatro APCD on February 20, 2027, with the show scheduled for 20:00. The event is organized by Estética Torta Produções.

events.title: Buffalo Tom — São Paulo
events.summary: FasTix lists Buffalo Tom at Cine Joia on February 27, 2027 at 19:00. The São Paulo show is part of the band’s first announced Brazil run, with local realization by Maraty.
